candidates: When reviewing async rendering loops in diagram-dispatching code (e.g., `mermaid.ts`), check whether sequential `await`-in-a-loop or `Promise.all` is being used. In this project, `Promise.all` for parallel `render` calls is unsafe: diagram database modules (e.g., `flowDb.js`) rely on module-level mutable state, so concurrent renders corrupt each other's output. Sequential `await` is the required pattern. If a reviewer raises `Promise.all` as a performance improvement, note this as a known architectural limitation tracked in issue #3577 rather than a straightforward refactor opportunity.
